Served items: chicken wrap (~350 kcal), 4 sushi pieces (~160 kcal; the first photo shows 3 on the plate, plus possibly one more, but the second photo shows 2 left, so I'll assume 3-4 were served), grilled cheese sandwich (~400 kcal), fruit bowl (~100 kcal), latte (~120 kcal), cola (~100 kcal), soy sauce (~10 kcal).

Served total: 350 + 130 (3 sushi) + 400 + 100 + 120 + 100 + 10 = 1210 kcal.

Leftovers: about 2 sushi pieces (~85 kcal), roughly 1/3 of the wrap (the wrap remnant looks like mostly tortilla, ~100 kcal), and the soy sauce (~8 kcal). The cola glass is empty, though it holds water or ice. The latte is mostly finished.

Leftover total: about 190 kcal.

Eaten: 1210 - 190 = 1020 kcal.

Macros for the amount eaten: protein ~38 g, carbs ~125 g, fat ~40 g. This gives 152 + 500 + 360 = 1012 kcal, which is consistent.
